purpose: Continuously extract precise unproved mathematical assets without confusing experiments, open questions, proved tools, or failed ideas with conjectures; preserve and propagate conjectural dependency taint.
scan_surfaces: control-plane task frontiers and smallest unresolved units

all_required: There is an asserted direction rather than a directionless question.
The claim can be frozen into a precise falsifiable statement or reusable tool contract.
The full frozen scope is not already proved/certified.
Source provenance and the current evidence envelope are identifiable.
A counterexample, failed certificate, or proof target could in principle decide or restrict it.

confidence_tiers.A_REGISTER: Explicit conjecture/hypothesis or exact research reduction to a clearly unproved external/internal target; register now.
confidence_tiers.B_FREEZE_THEN_REGISTER: Repeated empirical/structural regularity with a clear direction but wording still loose; first freeze scope and falsifier, then register.
confidence_tiers.C_REVIEW_ONLY: Potential signal lacking a stable statement, validation envelope, or provenance; keep in scan audit, do not register.
confidence_tiers.D_EXCLUDE: Falls under a hard false-positive class.

hard_false_positive_classes.PROVED_OR_CERTIFIED_RESULT: The mathematical statement/correctness is already proved for its advertised scope.
hard_false_positive_classes.EXACT_TOOL_WITH_EXPERIMENTAL_PERFORMANCE: Correctness is proved; only speed, memory, utility, or crossover performance is empirical.
hard_false_positive_classes.OPEN_QUESTION_NO_ASSERTED_DIRECTION: The source asks what is true without betting on a falsifiable direction.
hard_false_positive_classes.IMPLEMENTATION_OR_ACCEPTANCE_GAP: Established mathematics awaits code, reviewer approval, or toolbox promotion.
hard_false_positive_classes.RAW_OBSERVATION_NOT_FROZEN: Numerical pattern has not yet been converted to a precise mathematical claim.
hard_false_positive_classes.AXIOM_CANDIDATE: Use the separate axiom-candidate state machine.
hard_false_positive_classes.REFUTED_CANDIDATE_WITHOUT_SURVIVING_REST: The proposed law/tool was falsified and there is no surviving narrower claim to register.
hard_false_positive_classes.PERFORMANCE_ONLY_NEGATIVE_OR_POSITIVE: Finite benchmark outcome alone is not a mathematical conjecture.

dependency_model.taint_definition: An asset/result is conjecture-tainted iff its proof, advertised soundness, or claimed scope transitively uses at least one conjectural asset not PROVED for the exact used scope.

transition_rules.CONJECTURE_TO_EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED: Retain all conjectural taint; update evidence envelope and proof priority only.
transition_rules.ANY_TO_PROVED: Clear only the taint contributed by the proved asset for the exact proved scope; traverse reverse dependencies and re-evaluate them. Never auto-promote a dependent whose own obligations or other conjectural dependencies remain.
transition_rules.ANY_TO_RESTRICTED: Compute invalidated scope intersection and mark every dependent using that scope REVIEW_REQUIRED.
transition_rules.ANY_TO_REFUTED: Every ESSENTIAL dependent using the refuted scope becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED and must be restricted, re-derived, parked, superseded, or refuted; heuristic-only dependents keep historical outputs but may not cite the refuted claim as support.
transition_rules.ANY_TO_SUPERSEDED: Replacement does not clear taint unless the replacement logically covers the exact scope used by each dependent.
transition_rules.CYCLE_RULE: Strongly connected components of unresolved conjectural dependencies never self-promote; each cycle requires an external proof/falsifier or an explicit restriction that breaks the cycle.

bounded_claim_rule: An explicitly finite claim can move directly to PROVED after exhaustive exact/replayable certification of the entire frozen domain; this does not prove any unstated infinite extension.
scan_priority: claims already driving active research tasks
finite claims with cheap exact certification paths
scanner_invariant: The scanner may make the registry more complete, but never more certain than the evidence warrants.
